author: Dutch Harbour
text: Barry and his son are honest, dependable, and completed a quality instalation on our property. He designed the system and helped to navigate the permitting process. The project cost was well within the alloted budget, he is a fair contractor with true integrity, highly recommend!

author: Andrew Cupp
text: Excellent experience with Phippin & Son on a full septic replacement. They navigated the BRF grant process with us and the county without a hitch. Thorough, professional, and great to work with from start to finish.

author: Kendra Mounts
text: Justin is TOP TIER! Always readily available to help us with any issues we’ve had. He has quite literally been our Superman coming to save the day! We appreciate his quick response and urgency to get things done the right way! Thank you!!

author: Nate E
text: Hard working, prompt service, and high quality of work. I contacted  BL Phippin & Son construction llc, through a reference to help with an electrical failure of my Lpp control box due to moisture. Justin quickly came out and temporarily got it working until they could replaced the whole box and  its components. I would highly recommend contacting them if you’re looking for repairs or install.

author: Joshua Wharton
text: Justin and his team are top notch. Very knowledgeable and thorough. Explained what processes very well, which let us know what to expect. Wish I could give 10 stars. Highly recommend.
